title: thin clear plastic table cloth
text: thin clear plastic table cloth. This is NOT a high quality thick, clear table cloth - but it is useful for a short time.  The edges are sewn with a thick white thread/yarn.  It lasted for the short time I needed it on the table.  I will use it for a drop cloth of some sort now.  Just a reminder, it is very thin and not meant for long time use - in my opinion.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
